name: What factors influence the total cost of a garage renovation?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the total cost of a garage renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Total costs depend largely on square footage, wall finishing needs, and electrical demands. A basic cosmetic refresh focused on drywall patching and interior painting sits on the lower end of remodeling budgets. Extensive conversions that require custom framing for storage rooms, heavy insulation, subpanel additions, and finished carpentry work will raise project costs. To keep budgets predictable, determine whether your garage requires full temperature regulation or specialized 240V circuits before design begins, which helps prioritize core structural carpentry over optional decorative elements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on square footage, framing needs, drywall installation, insulation, and the complexity of electrical sub-trade work for equipment or lighting.
